crosswalks.label: Management Analysts
crosswalks.rationale: Management Analysts is a bounded occupational baseline for Change Management Specialist; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Change Management must keep adoption, compliance, understanding and underlying-change correctness separate, with dissent preserved as evidence rather than noise.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make adoption-versus-correctness, compliance-versus-consent and dissent-handling boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Change Management Specialist reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
